verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API whose root resource links to all other resources, plus endpoints for audience contacts, campaigns and full account exports, so an agent has a programmatic path into the email program. However, the evidence never shows API access to live automations or to campaign report metrics: open and click reporting is described only as UI help content, and Analytics AI's 'what's working' explanations are a built-in feature, not agent-accessible data. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for reading automations, documented API access to campaign reports and metrics, evidence of agent or MCP read integration (the AI chat mention covers campaign creation only), hands-on corroboration.
